notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor evaluating Redwood.
POC path: hosted API quickstart -> 4-week Dedicated POC to validate latency/throughput and VPC integration.
Requirements (from CTO & infra): 95th pct latency <200ms for chat flows, 99th <350ms; sustained throughput ~200 req/s with ability to burst to 800; embeddings throughput target 120 vectors/sec for 1536-d models.
Security: strong - SSO (SAML), KMS for key management, audit logs retention 90 days, data residency in US, SOC2 evidence required by vendor risk.
Legal: submitted MSA redlines 2026-03-02. Key asks: carve-outs around customer data, limited liability cap, DPA obligations (subprocessor list), breach notification SLA (48 hours), cyber insurance proof.
Quote: preliminary Dedicated sizing estimate shared by AE (2 x A100-equivalent nodes, autoscale headroom) — finance asked for committed monthly pricing and overage rates.
POC success criteria: meet latency SLOs at target throughput, VPC peering validated, KMS integration test, and passing security questionnaire.
Customer voice: "We like the batching/caching suggestions — but can't accept open indemnity. Need tighter DPA language." — CTO (Mar 2 call).
Short-hand next: legal + Redwood legal sync, finalize pricing SOW, security evidence upload (SOC2), schedule onboarding runbook review.
